verified_behaviors: missing comparison metrics keep the UI at reference-canvas, mark later gates not-run or locked, and emit no correction intent
failed silhouette metrics show silhouette-blockout and lock structure, form and surface/material guidance
structure and form gates are cumulative and cannot be unlocked by material or heatmap UI state
the contour canvas button selects the silhouette AOV and overlay mode in one read-only action, keeping the camera/reference comparison fixed
the contour canvas may add a deterministic border-connected flood-fill reference contour aid in browser memory for visual guidance only
the surface/material row is only a transient can-enter hint after the form gate passes
the panel names ReferenceComparisonReport@1 and QualityReport as the authoritative truth boundary
the panel derives a bounded Codex correction queue: silhouette, landmark, form and surface intents are emitted in cumulative order with failed metrics and one-Part/one-MaterialZone constraints
the panel uses only candidate-bound visual QualityReport@2 status for visual unlocks; a structural candidate quality_hard_gate_passed fallback cannot clear the visual queue
the panel fails closed when viewer_visual_evidence is unavailable and does not fall back to a generic candidate quality projection or render hash
the correction queue never contains geometry parameters, never moves the camera and never invokes a Runtime write tool
the panel never invokes Runtime write tools and never persists image bytes, UI state or new quality evidence
